title: Learning English with Games
topic: เทคโนโลยี/การศึกษา
lines: Can playing video games improve your English? A group of researchers in
Finland thinks so. They studied 400 teenagers and found that **those** who
played online games with international players for more than five hours
a week had a much larger English vocabulary than **those** who did not.
The researchers believe the reason is simple: in team games, players must
communicate quickly to win. **They** cannot stop to look up every word, so
they learn useful phrases by hearing and using them again and again.
However, the study does not say that all games are good teachers. Games
with very little talking, such as puzzle games, showed no effect. Also,
players learned mostly informal English. **Few** knew how to write a formal
email or a school essay. The researchers suggest that games should be a
fun extra, not a replacement for reading and writing practice. Parents, they
say, should not worry about every hour of gaming, but **this** does not mean
that children can play all night.
